entry_rationale: Pay 25 million March 2027 AONIA; Australia prices only 16.5bp of hikes versus much more in the US and Canadian strips.
entry_thesis: Oil at Brent 109.86 and WTI 101.41, with VIX 16.46, keeps a pro-cyclical inflation impulse in force, yet AONIA March 2027 at 4.765 sits only 16.5bp above cash 4.60 while SOFR March already prices 59.5bp and CORRA March prices 72bp. Paying AONIA March 2027 is the cleanest live way to express growth-and-commodity catch-up: more room for the Australian path to reprice higher, and less already-priced tightening to lose if the hike path is deleted. The Canada March 2027 pay stays on for the same impulse; the drift from 3.13 to 2.99 is a fade, not a regime change, and it is not a size-up.

events.rationale: Pay 25 million March 2027 AONIA; Australia prices only 16.5bp of hikes versus much more in the US and Canadian strips.

invalidation: Cover the new AONIA pay if March implied moves back to cash 4.60 without a higher cash rate, or if an energy and risk break from Brent 109.86, the S&P near 7659, and VIX 16.46 would justify Australian cuts rather than catch-up hikes. The Canada short is separately wrong if CORRA March keeps falling toward cash 2.27.
